_note: FROZEN PUBLIC METRIC SCHEMA (closing contract §2/§7/§8). The authoritative description of which quantities are SCIENTIFIC PREDICATES and which are diagnostics, mirrored byte-for-byte from tools/tier3_scaffolded_evaluation/tier3_metrics.py (bound by LF-SHA below; the metrics module self-test fails closed on ANY drift). Scientific predicates / terminal labels / metric aggregation belong ONLY to the common evaluator; candidate runtimes must NOT define their own success conditions. Cross-GPU agreement requirements for the determinism preflight are fixed in bit_agreement_policy.

full.primary_semantics: P(defeat kobold | valid full start) over the frozen held-out canonical reset seeds 200000..200063

front_l2.primary_semantics: P(player level 2 -> 3 | valid frozen FRONT start), conditional on the frozen 8-state FRONT bank
front_l2.dense_semantics: frozen graph-distance progress in [0,1]; diagnostic progress measure, NOT a success substitute (is_success_substitute=false)
front_l2.pending_equivalence_alias_note: corridor_exit_reached is reported only as PENDING_EQUIVALENCE_ALIAS, never primary

back_l2.primary_semantics: P(defeat kobold | valid frozen BACK start), conditional on the frozen 8-state BACK bank; a CONDITIONAL combat predicate, never a boss-search claim
back_l2.diagnostics_role: diagnostic_only (kobold_engaged / survival diagnostics never override the primary)

selection_predicate_rule._note: frozen lexicographic cross-arm comparator (tier3_provisional_selection); PROVISIONAL only this round; no scientific-superiority claim, multi-seed confirmation required.

bit_agreement_policy._note: closing contract §8 cross-GPU determinism preflight. Canonical fields below MUST be BIT-IDENTICAL across two GPUs for the same checkpoint + same frozen bank + same canonical world; the FIRST canonical mismatch stops the preflight with CROSS_GPU_DETERMINISM_PREFLIGHT=FAIL (no regeneration of the bank to dodge a difference; no loosening). Non-canonical fields may legitimately differ and are never preflight predicates.
bit_agreement_policy.jax_float_diagnostic_rule: if a JAX float value that is NOT part of the canonical episode record differs non-bitwise across GPUs, FIRST check whether this schema / the metric module makes it a preflight predicate (it does not, unless listed in bit_exact_fields); report it as an observed diagnostic note without failing the preflight; any field listed above failing to agree is a HARD FAIL

prohibitions: candidate runtimes defining their own FRONT/BACK/FULL success conditions
boss-search or boss-area-reach claims from BACK scaffolds
ad-hoc seed sets not frozen in configs/tier3_evaluation_profile_v1.json
